$comment: Taxonomy-valued fields carry an x-taxonomy annotation naming the dimension in factory/policies/taxonomy.yml. The runtime validates those values against that file at write time; enums are never inlined here to avoid drift between the schema and the taxonomy (architecture §8).
title: Finding Evidence
description: What a judge actually returns when its mandate is to FIND: evidence, no identity. finding.schema.json describes the record the orchestrator stores, and requires six fields a judge cannot know — finding_id, task_id, fingerprint, finding_status, found_by, found_by_provider — which findings.ts then refuses to accept from a judge (findings.evidence-carries-identity). Asking an external finder for that shape means asking it to invent a sha256 and a status, and throwing both away. This schema is the judge's half of the contract; mintFindings() adds the other half.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path the finding is anchored to, normalized (forward slashes, no leading ./). The fingerprint's first component.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs -> wrong output. A finding without one dies at verify (agent-interviews.md V-2).

criterion_ref.description: Which acceptance criterion the evidence is against. Evidence, not identity: a spec reviewer legitimately knows which criterion it read, and cannot know the plan version it was dispatched on.
